question: What consequence follows from abstaining from food by day?
premises: Abstention from eating by day is specified.
Death related to age is named.
inference: By not eating during the day, one will go to death from age.
uncertainties: The intended sense of vayo-mṛtyuṃ is somewhat ambiguous without broader context.
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go to death by age.
